The primary responsibilities include:

* Drafting provisional and non\-provisional applications in compliance with USPTO, EPO and PCT rules and requirements.

**Skill required:** User\-Generated Content Moderation \- Content Moderation  

**Designation:** Trust \& Safety New Associate  

**Qualifications:**Any Graduation
  

**Years of Experience:**0 to 1 years
  

**About Accenture**  

Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security.Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song— all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 784,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.Visit us at www.accenture.com
  

**What would you do?** • Accenture is a trusted, innovative, comprehensive, and experienced partner to leading platform companies and other organizations. The Trust and Safety (Content Moderation and Responsible AI) offering(s) within Accenture helps keep the internet safe and helps platform companies accelerate, scale, and improve their businesses. • Accentures Trust and Safety team, serves as an important line of defense by helping improve the quality and safety of online content while gaining hands on job experience. They often systematically test, evaluate, and challenge AI systems and platforms to improve the integrity, quality and safety of content, including generative AI. You will deliver value to our clients, while making a larger impact on society. • Seeking a detail\-oriented, resourceful candidate for a Tier 1 Copyright legal support role. Key duties include reviewing web content for policy and legal compliance, evaluating takedown requests, counter\-notices, inquiries, and retractions for abuse, and applying core copyright rules to daily workflows. You will also escalate complex issues beyond standard scope. “You will be responsible for analyzing and reviewing user profiles, audio, videos, and text\-based content and/or investigating, escalating and/or resolving issues that are reported by users or flagged by the system. Due to the nature of the role, the individual may be exposed to flashing lights or contrasting light and dark patterns. Content moderation is meaningful work that helps keep the internet safe. It may also be challenging, at times. In the context of this role, individuals may be directly or inadvertently exposed to potentially objectionable and sensitive content (e.g., graphic, violent, sexual, or egregious). Therefore, content moderators need strong resilience and coping skills. We care for the health and well\-being of our people and provide the support and resources needed to perform their role responsibilities. Active participation in Accenture’s well\-being support program, designed specifically for the Trust \& Safety community, provides valuable skills to promote individual and collective well\-being.”  

**What are we looking for?** • "Excellent comprehension, communication, and (insert language) skills. • Strong investigative and analytical skills. • Excellent Decision making skills \-independent and within sub\-groups. • Good knowledge of social media, associated technologies and online trends. • Can critically assess content strictly against client guidelines.
  

**Roles and Responsibilities:** • "Process and analyze complex legal removal requests efficiently and accurately for international complaints according to client guidelines and procedures. • Process and review content that has been flagged for review of potentially sensitive content. • Validate, investigate and respond to inquiries of an urgent or sensitive nature within established guidelines. This includes coordinating with client subject matter experts to respond to or support in response to inquiries and or escalations which may include but not limited to external third parties, Client or Accenture. • Resolve and or escalate takedown requests, counter notification, retraction and General Inquiry tickets in T1 queues and other queues as assigned. • Comply with all client published policies and procedures and any legal and regulatory requirements that the company is obliged to adhere to. • Assigned and accountable for workable solutions and processes within a specific area of responsibility. • Demonstrates speed, agility, critical thinking, and problem solving skills in their work and an ability to ramp up quickly. • Receive feedback and apply learnings quickly in changing environment. • Escalates issues and questionable removals to Operations Manager or client Point of Contact as appropriate. • Addresses most non routine issues. • Ensures all work is performed in accordance with SLAs and metrics. • Attain 96 Quality Score. Responsible for activities assigned by the Operations Manager. • Please note this role may require you to work in rotational shifts.

description:
**Why join us?**
 Our purpose is design for the good of humankind. It’s the ideal we strive toward each day in everything we do. Being a part of MillerKnoll means being a part of something larger than your work team, or even your brand. We are redefining modern for the 21st century. And our success allows MillerKnoll to support causes that align with our values, so we can build a more sustainable, equitable, and beautiful future for everyone.
   

  

**Governance, Risk and Compliance Engineer**
 Purpose / Profile
   

  

 The MillerKnoll Governance, Risk, and Compliance Engineer will work collaboratively with global cross\-functional teams to centrally perform Cybersecurity and Privacy compliance, data governance, identity governance, and risk management functions. The engineer will have primary responsibility for managing GRC and IAM platforms, implementing APIs and automations to support cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, and access governance practices, and investigating the use of AI to improve GRC and IAM processes. This position works closely with the Legal, Internal Audit, Cybersecurity, Identity and Access Management, and Technology teams to help ensure that contractual, policy, control, procedural, legal, and regulatory obligations are effectively defined and implemented.
   

  

 The engineer must be collaborative and flexible while developing solutions that meet changing cybersecurity and privacy requirements while supporting business function needs. This individual will help grow and mature risk and compliance processes to gain efficiencies and effectiveness in collaboration with all departments to ensure an acceptable risk posture for the organization. This position requires a deep understanding of existing data protection laws and regulations, such as the EU\-GDPR and CCPA/CPRA, but also be focused on broader implications of protections as a function of information/system lifecycle management and security and privacy by design. The engineer must possess high standards of legal and business ethics and a demonstrated ability to understand technology, independently problem solve, analyze large quantities of data, and clearly summarize and communicate facts.
   

  

**Essential Functions**
* Manage GRC and IAM platforms and their associated modules, workflows, integrations, and reporting capabilities.
* Develop compliance and identity automation to improve business processes, reduce manual effort, and strengthen audit readiness.
* Investigate AI opportunities to improve GRC, IAM, access review, and compliance functions.
* Implement APIs and integrations for our GRC and IAM platforms and other enterprise systems to support GRC controls, access governance, evidence collection, and compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with key business partners on use cases for GRC and IAM platforms, including risk management, compliance workflows, user access reviews, identity lifecycle processes, and access governance.
* Develop documentation on how to use GRC and IAM platforms, including platform administration, workflow support, integrations, and recurring compliance processes.
* Train business partners on how to use GRC and IAM platforms effectively and consistently.
* Interpret and apply laws, regulations, policies, standards, or procedures to specific issues.
* Work cooperatively with applicable organization units in implanting consumer information access rights.
* Serve as a liaison for GRC and IAM platforms to the organization.
* Monitor systems development and operations for security and privacy compliance


**Additional Functions**
* Stay current with compliance news and trends relevant to the business and industry.
* Participate in providing support for compliance\-related incidents.
* Interface with other business units such as Cybersecurity to communicate program status and overall compliance and training posture.
* Promote a positive security/compliance culture through knowledge sharing, influences, and conduct.
* Create and maintain role\-specific documentation.
* Assist with our government, risk, and compliance projects as time permits.


**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**
* Knowledge of Payment Card Industry (PCI) data security standards.
* Knowledge of Personally Identifiable Information (PII) data security standards.
* Knowledge of Personal Health Information (PHI) data security standards.
* Knowledge of Risk Management Framework (RMF) requirements.
* Knowledge of risk/threat assessment.
* Knowledge of laws, policies, procedures, or governance relevant to Cybersecurity for critical infrastructures.
* Knowledge of external organizations and academic institutions with a cyber focus (e.g., cyber curriculum/training and Research \& Development).
* Knowledge of controls related to data use, processing, storage, and transmission.
* Skill in applying confidentiality, integrity, and availability principles.
* Skill in conducting information searches.
* Ability to communicate effectively when writing.
* Ability to apply critical reading/thinking skills.
* Interpret and apply laws, regulations, policies, standards, or procedures to specific issues.
* Provide ongoing optimization and problem\-solving support for GRC and IAM platforms, integrations, workflows, and reporting.
* Provide recommendations for possible improvements and upgrades.
* Ability to tailor technical and planning information to a customer's level of understanding.
* Ability to work across departments and business units to implement the organization’s privacy principles and programs and align privacy objectives with security objectives.


**Qualifications**
 Education/Experience
   

  

* Bachelor in Information Systems, Cybersecurity, or Business administration
* 4\+ years of relevant experience in Internal Audit, Compliance, or Information Technology


- 

 Licenses and Certifications
   

  

* One or more compliance certifications are preferred (e.g., CIPP, CIPM, CIPT, PCIP, QSA, CISA)


**Who We Hire?**
 Simply put, we hire qualified applicants representing a wide range of backgrounds and abilities. MillerKnoll is comprised of people of all abilities, gender identities and expressions, ages, ethnicities, sexual orientations, veterans from every branch of military service, and more. Here, you can bring your whole self to work. We’re committed to equal opportunity employment, including veterans and people with disabilities.
   

  

 MillerKnoll complies with applicable disability laws and makes reasonable accommodations for applicants and employees with disabilities. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact MillerKnoll Talent Acquisition at careers\_help@millerknoll.com.

* Engage, manage, and coordinate with external counsel for specialized matters, including due diligence and complex advisory.

* Drive continuous improvement in contract lifecycle management, compliance monitoring frameworks, and overall risk management processes.

* Experience in a reputed law firm and/or in\-house role with exposure to corporate advisory, transactions, and compliance.

**Overall Purpose Of Job**
 We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Patent Services Professional to create high quality patent applications and (preferably) support patent prosecution activities by collaborating with inventors, clients, and external counsel. The role involves conducting invention disclosure discussions, assessing patentability, drafting and reviewing applications, guiding drafting teams, and contributing to Office Action responses. The candidate is expected to maintain high standards of quality, communication, excellent delivery, while operating with a strong client ownership mindset.
   

  

 The candidate’s key strengths \& competencies are as below:
   

  

* Strong technical acumen with the ability to understand complex inventions quickly.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with clarity in both technical and legal articulation.
* Sound problem solving ability and balanced technical/legal judgment.
* Demonstrated ability to deliver high quality work while meeting SLA, deadline, and productivity expectations.
* Ability to work collaboratively with inventors, internal teams, and external counsel.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, and documentation discipline.
* Proactive approach for continuous improvement, training, and process optimization.

description:
**Head of Anti\-Piracy \& Platform Partnerships**
**About the Role:**
 JioStar is India's leading media and entertainment business, home to JioHotstar (500M\+ monthly active users) and the exclusive home of the IPL (₹47,551 Cr rights value), ICC events and India's most\-watched entertainment. With piracy costing India's video sector an estimated $1\.2 billion annually, content protection is a key priority.
   

  

 This is a build\-and\-lead mandate. The function operates as a lean, intelligence\-led command centre. The Head of Anti\-Piracy \& Platform Partnerships will own operational strategy, platform governance, vendor management, law enforcement coordination and live\-event readiness across domestic and future international markets.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities:**
**Strategy \& Operations:**
* Own end\-to\-end execution of JioStar's anti\-piracy strategy across broadcast, OTT, IPTV, social media and emerging ecosystems.
* Define the function's operating model, KPIs and business\-impact metrics — moving beyond volume\-based takedown counts.
* Lead international expansion planning: jurisdictional scoping, coalition partnerships, and phased capability build\-out.


**Platform Partnerships \& Escalation:**
* Own senior relationships with Meta, Google/YouTube, Telegram, ISPs, hosting providers, registrars and CDNs.
* Lead escalation pathways for high\-priority takedowns, repeat\-offender action and live\-event enforcement.
* Represent JioStar in industry coalitions and platform trust \& safety forums (ACE, IBCAP, AAPA and equivalents).


**Live\-Event Anti\-Piracy Operations:**
* Command the live\-event anti\-piracy operation for IPL, ICC and premium events — 24/7 control\-room oversight, mobilization within hours.
* Establish playbooks for restream takedowns, app\-store enforcement and ISP\-level blocking during marquee fixtures.


**Intelligence, Investigations \& Vendor Governance:**
* Oversee the Intelligence \& Investigations and the Data, Automation \& Vendor Governance portfolio; ensure intelligence precedes every enforcement action.
* Govern the external vendor ecosystem: set SLAs, manage performance, rationalize the partner footprint and drive automation.


**Law Enforcement, Legal \& Regional Coordination:**
* Build senior relationships with national and state law enforcement, cyber cells, and MIB.
* Direct Regional Enforcement Coordinators on field operations, raids and state\-level piracy disruption.
* Partner with in\-house Legal on orders, dynamic injunctions, site\-blocking and criminal complaints.


**Executive Engagement:**
* Drive cross\-functional coordination with Business, Legal, Distribution, Content Operations and Technology.
* Deliver executive reporting on threat landscape, enforcement outcomes and business impact to senior leadership.


**Required Experience \& Capabilities:**
* 15\+ years in OTT, digital media, broadcasting or Trust \& Safety, with a meaningful share in content protection, anti\-piracy, fraud or platform integrity.
* Proven track record managing complex, multi\-stakeholder enforcement programs at scale across digital, broadcast and physical distribution.
* Direct engagement with Meta, Google/YouTube, Telegram, ISPs and hosting providers at a senior governance level.
* Deep, current understanding of digital piracy ecosystems — illegal IPTV networks, restream chains, Telegram piracy, cyberlockers and app\-based modalities.
* Intelligence orientation — approaches problems as an investigator, not an operator; comfortable with attribution analysis and OSINT outputs.
* Systems thinking, platform ecosystem fluency, operational maturity and strong stakeholder management at executive, regulatory and law\-enforcement levels.
* Live\-event content protection operations experience strongly preferred.


**Alternative Backgrounds Considered:**
*JioStar will actively consider Ex\-Armed Forces SSC officers (Indian Navy / Air Force) from Signals, Intelligence, Cyber or Information Warfare backgrounds with demonstrable platform\-ecosystem fluency.*

Senior Legal Manager
description:
**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on Legal Manager to manage day\-to\-day legal, contractual and compliance matters supporting operations across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and India.
 



 The role requires a commercially practical lawyer who can independently manage contracts, legal research, documentation, compliance tracking, operational claims and coordination with external counsel.
 



  





 This is an individual\-contributor role with meaningful ownership. It is not a Head of Legal position, and jurisdiction\-specific UAE and Saudi legal opinions will be supported by qualified local counsel.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Commercial Contracts** 



* Draft, review and negotiate commercial agreements, NDAs, vendor agreements, technology agreements, service agreements, partnership agreements and other business contracts.
* Prepare and review agreements with operational partners, suppliers, corporate customers, dealerships, garages, insurers and other business partners.
* Review customer\-facing terms, subscription conditions, cancellation and refund policies, promotional terms and other consumer documentation.
* Identify contractual risks relating to liability, indemnity, insurance, data protection, intellectual property, termination, payment terms, service levels and dispute resolution.
* Maintain standard templates, fallback positions and practical negotiation playbooks for recurring agreements.



  





**Regulatory and Compliance Support** 



* Research and monitor laws and regulations relevant to business activities across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and India.
* Support management in assessing regulatory requirements relating to mobility, transport, consumer protection, employment, outsourcing, digital services and data protection.
* Coordinate with external legal counsel in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and India, prepare clear instructions and convert external advice into actionable recommendations.
* Maintain a country\-wise compliance calendar, licence tracker, legal risk register and regulatory documentation repository.
* Support legal reviews for new services, partnerships, product features, market launches and operational changes.
* Assist with responses to regulators, authorities and formal legal notices in coordination with external counsel.



  





**Operational Claims and Disputes** 



* Support the handling of customer complaints, accidents, vehicle\-damage claims, insurance matters, partner breaches, employee disputes and other operational incidents.
* Review the relevant contracts, evidence, insurance position and potential liability before recommending a course of action.
* Draft and respond to legal notices, settlement correspondence, breach notices and other dispute\-related communications.
* Coordinate with operations, insurance providers, external counsel and other stakeholders to resolve matters efficiently.
* Maintain proper records of disputes, claims, settlements and ongoing legal exposure.



  





**Corporate and Employment Matters** 



* Support corporate governance requirements, including resolutions, signing authorities, corporate records, intercompany agreements and statutory documentation.
* Assist with employment agreements, confidentiality obligations, intellectual\-property assignments, employee policies, disciplinary matters and terminations.
* Support HR with workplace investigations and sensitive employee matters where legal review is required.
* Coordinate statutory and corporate compliance for India operations with company secretarial, tax and external legal advisers.



  





**Data Protection, Technology and Intellectual Property** 



* Review privacy policies, data\-processing agreements, technology contracts and vendor data\-protection terms.
* Support compliance relating to customer, employee and partner data, including location information, call recordings, identity documents and cross\-border data access.
* Coordinate with technology and information\-security teams on data incidents, vendor risk and privacy requirements.
* Protect intellectual property through appropriate contractual provisions, employee and contractor assignments, confidentiality controls and trademark coordination.



  





**Fundraising and Strategic Matters** 



* Support legal due diligence, document collection, data\-room management and responses to investor legal queries.
* Assist external counsel and management with financing documents, investment transactions, corporate restructuring and other strategic matters.
* Track post\-transaction obligations, approvals, reporting requirements and contractual commitments.



  





**Legal Operations** 



* Own the contract repository and ensure executed agreements, amendments and supporting documents are properly maintained.
* Track contract renewals, notice periods, expiry dates, commercial commitments and compliance obligations.
* Develop practical legal templates, internal policies, approval workflows and documentation standards.
* Maintain visibility on pending contracts, claims, legal notices, regulatory matters and external\-counsel assignments.
* Use appropriate contract\-management and productivity tools to improve turnaround time and reduce manual work.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Bachelor's degree in Law and enrolment with a recognised Bar Council in India.
* Approximately 5 to 8 years of post\-qualification legal experience.
* Meaningful in\-house experience, preferably within a startup, technology\-enabled business, marketplace, logistics, mobility, fintech or consumer\-services company.
* Strong experience in drafting, reviewing and negotiating commercial contracts.
* Working knowledge of Indian corporate, commercial, employment, consumer and data\-protection laws.
* Exposure to operational disputes, insurance claims, customer complaints, employment matters or regulatory compliance.
* Experience supporting international or cross\-border business operations is preferred.
* UAE or Saudi legal exposure is advantageous but not mandatory.
* Ability to conduct structured legal research and work effectively with jurisdiction\-specific external counsel.
* Strong commercial judgment and the ability to distinguish material legal risks from manageable business risks.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, particularly the ability to explain legal issues to non\-legal stakeholders.
* High attention to detail, strong ownership and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-moving environment.
* Comfort working closely with teams based in the UAE, Saudi Arabia and India.



  





**What Success Looks Like** 



* Commercial contracts are completed accurately and within agreed timelines.
* Legal risks are identified early and communicated clearly.
* Agreements, renewals, claims and compliance obligations are properly tracked.
* External counsel is engaged efficiently and provided with clear, complete instructions.
* Management receives practical recommendations, not only summaries of the law.
* Legal processes become faster, more consistent and easier for business teams to use.

 It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention.  Join us to put AI to work for people.
   

  

**Job Description**
 The Platform Architect is a trusted advisor for enterprise platform strategy and governance. You define platform standards and guide technical decisions to ensure ServiceNow remains healthy, scalable, and aligned to customer goals.
   

  

 Your purpose is to establish governance models, anticipate risks, and enable sustainable growth. You engage across CxO, enterprise architects, and platform teams to influence decisions and ensure consistency across the program.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Define and maintain platform vision and strategy aligned to enterprise IT and business objectives.
* Provide architectural guidance to ensure designs align with platform standards and leading practices.
* Shape governance frameworks covering instance strategy, integrations, and data models.
* Facilitate platform governance forums to drive consistent decisions across partners and teams.
* Anticipate and mitigate platform risks (scalability, performance, technical debt).
* Influence adoption of leading practices across customer, partner, and ServiceNow teams.
* Provide structured feedback to ServiceNow product and engineering teams.
* Travel of up to 50% annually may be expected.


**What Success Looks Like**
* ServiceNow is embedded as a strategic enterprise platform with clear governance models in place.
* Platform standards are consistently applied across all delivery teams.
* Technical risks are reduced, and scalability is maintained.
* You are recognised as a trusted advisor on platform strategy and governance, complementing the CSE’s business\-value leadership.


**Qualifications**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision\-making, or problem\-solving. This may include using AI\-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI\-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 12\+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution strategy, and program leadership.
* Proven experience engaging at Executive level to influence platform direction and business outcomes.
* Track record of defining multi\-workflow, enterprise\-scale architectures and governance models.
* Strong ability to operate as a program\-level architect, guiding multiple teams and partners toward a unified vision.

description:
Senior Project Lead
   

  

 Project and Development Services – (Chennai/India)
   

  

 What this job involves:
   

  

 Leading projects to success
   

  

 As Senior Project Lead you’ll take total responsibility for the overall success of major
   

  

 projects—guiding teams in each phase to achieve outcomes that exceed clients’
   

  

 expectations and meet JLL’s commercial objectives. Driven and ambitious by nature, you
   

  

 have a mastery of the ins and outs of business—from products and systems to processes,
   

  

 tools and best practices. You’ll need to collaborate effectively with a range of stakeholders,
   

  

 leading from the front while also taking the time to understand their point of view.
   

  

 For each project, you’ll establish an effective organisational structure for reporting,
   

  

 communication and working procedures, and ensure that clear objectives and quality
   

  

 control systems are in place. You’ll lead a project team that is highly motivated, eager to
   

  

 contribute, and in sync with the stakeholders’ mind\-sets. You’ll also attend project
   

  

 meetings, submit monthly reports, and monitor project budgets, so an eye for detail and a
   

  

 structured approach to tasks will serve you well.
   

  

 Making clients our first priority
   

  

 The best person for this job is one who always considers what’s best for our clients. As
   

  

 such, you’ll maintain a strong and positive relationship with our clients by identifying
   

  

 their needs, requirements and constraints. While you act in the clients’ best interests
   

  

 throughout the project duration, you must make sure that the project’s revenue and
   

  

 payment cycles are properly managed.
   

  

 Keeping an eye on business opportunities is also among the highlights of the job. Do you
   

  

 have a knack for building rapport with prospects? Your expertise in surveying a client’s
   

  

 needs and supporting the preparation of PM proposals is key. Likewise, skilfully
   

  

 developing relationships with other company business lines is a must; we achieve are
   

  

 biggest success when working together, so clear communication is key, as is
   

  

 collaboration and team work.
   

  

 Maintaining the JLL legacy
   

  

 We uphold excellence in everything we do—that has been essential to our more than 200
   

  

 years of staying power. As the person in charge, your task is to continue our tradition of
   

  

 project success. You’ll accomplish this by creating a network of professional consultants
   

  

**Who Can Deliver The Required Scope Of Every Project.**
 Likewise, you’ll handle contract administration of all vendors professionally and according
   

  

 to legal requirements. It’s the best way to protect both our and the clients’ commercial
   

  

 interests. Your expertise will also be central in identifying project risks and mitigating
   

  

 them. Furthermore, you’ll be responsible for developing project\-related reports, analyses
   

  

 and reviews regularly.
   

  

 Sound like you?
   

  

 Our successful Project Managers ...
   

  

 Engage confidently with internal and external stakeholders and see things from their
   

  

 perspective.
   

  

 Are driven to succeed and love achieving challenging goals.
   

  

 Bring a structured and organised approach to everything they do.
   

  

 Communicate and collaborate to achieve success.
   

  

 Thrive under pressure and deal effectively with tight deadlines and high expectations.
   

  

 To apply you need to be:
   

  

 Project\-smart and technology\-savvy
   

  

 We employ talent from a wide range of backgrounds, though typically you should have a
   

  

 degree in any property\-related discipline, and at least 10 to 12 years’ experience in
   

  

 design, construction or project management.
   

  

 Are you technology savvy? As the digital leader in project management, we use a range
   

  

 of technology platforms to deliver our projects.
   

  

 Do you have a deep understanding of the legal environment for each project in respect to
   

  

 planning, commercial aspects, and delivery? If your answers are ‘yes’, then you’re already
   

  

 one step ahead.
   

  

 A natural communicator
   

  

 This role calls for superior communication skills, as we’ll expect you to be able to handle
   

  

 complex conversations with business owners, senior executives, and decision makers. We
   

  

 believe in clear and straightforward communication and strong empathy and EQ at all
   

  

 times. Of course, you’ll be good at building team relationships and interacting effectively
   

  

 with stakeholders in and out of the organisation.
   

  

 What we can do for you:
   

  

 At JLL, our purpose is to shape the future of real estate for a better world.
   

  

 We make sure that you become the best version of yourself by helping you realise your
   

  

 full potential in an entrepreneurial and inclusive work environment. We will empower your
   

  

 ambitions through our dedicated Total Rewards Program, competitive pay and benefits
   

  

 package.

description:
As Senior Contracts Manager, you will provide strategic and commercially focused legal support across Bell’s operational, sales, pre\-sales, procurement, and senior management teams. You will ensure the business operates within a robust legal framework whilst supporting the achievement of its commercial objectives and driving revenue enablement, risk mitigation, and operational efficiency through best\-in\-class contracting practices.Working collaboratively across departments, you will deliver efficient, pragmatic, and commercially focused contract support, whilst also working closely with senior executives and coaching mentoring and developing junior members of the commercial contracts team.
   

  

* Lead the provision of clear, strategic, and commercially minded advice on complex contract terms, legal matters, and business risk across multiple areas of the business.
* Take ownership of reviewing, drafting, and negotiating a broad and complex range of agreements, including high\-value supplier and customer contracts, software licences, SaaS agreements, agency, reseller, subcontractor and service provision arrangements.
* Lead negotiations with customers and suppliers on complex or high\-value matters, acting as the primary point of contact and ensuring outcomes align with business objectives, company policies, and risk appetite.
* Oversees and continuously improves Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM), including contract registers, obligation tracking, renewals, amendments, and system optimisation, ensuring accuracy, accessibility, and compliance across the business.
* Act as a senior point of escalation for internal teams, providing guidance and support on complex on\-boarding, contractual disputes, claims, and legal risk matters.
* Monitor, interpret, and proactively communicate relevant legal and regulatory developments, assessing their impact on the business and recommending appropriate action (including data protection and other applicable regulatory frameworks).
* Engage, instruct, and strategically manage external legal counsel within agreed budgets, including oversight of matters involving Indian and other international jurisdictions, as well as specialist areas of law.
* Own and govern the business's suite of legal templates, driving regular reviews to ensure they remain current, commercially appropriate, and legally sound.

description:

* Maintain and continuously improve the compliance control set, the supporting evidence and the documentation required by regulatory and audit obligations (GDPR,NIS2, SAP security audits, SWIFT and GITC), covering:


 Ø Application change management and software development life cycle controls
   

  

 Ø Security hardening and vulnerability patching of operating systems and databases
   

  

 Ø IT user access permissions and periodic user access reviews
   

  

 Ø General user access — security audit logs, monitoring evidence and review
   

  

 Ø Privileged user access (ie Firefighter usage) and privileged activity review

* Run the day\-to\-day operation of the global security awareness programme: plan and launch phishing simulations and training campaigns, follow up completion, and report on results


 Ø Track training completion and phishing click/report rates, and propose improvements to campaign content, targeting and follow\-up
   

  

* Collaborate with the SAP Basis Security \& Authorization team to review and report SoD violations
* Coordinate the global vulnerability management process: consolidate scan results, prioritise on risk, track remediation with infrastructure, application and OT owners,and escalate overdue or high\-risk items

* Maintain the security governance documentation (policies, standards, procedures, control narratives and the exception register) and participate in ITSC and cyber security team meetings
* Ensure that Carmeuse's regulatory and audit compliance controls are secure and auditable, in
* line with the established security, audit and regulatory requirements (GDPR, NIS2, SAP security audits, SWIFT and GITC)
* Operate the global security awareness and vulnerability management follow\-up processes, driving measurable improvement in employee behaviour and remediation performance
* Maintain the compliance documentation, metrics and reporting used by the Global Security \& Compliance Manager and by IT leadership


**Key performance indicators :**
 Compliance and audit findings closed on time; vulnerability remediation
   

  

 performance against the agreed SLAs (critical / high); security awareness results (training completion rate, phishing simulation click and report rates); timeliness and quality of the compliance evidence, metrics and reporting.
   

  

**Required**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering / technology in Information Security, Computer Science, IT or a related field
* At least 8 years of experience in IT or cyber security, with hands\-on exposure to compliance, audit support and reporting (a GRC or internal audit background is an advantage)
* Working knowledge of regulatory and audit frameworks (GDPR, NIS2, SAP security audits, SWIFT,GITC);
* Mandatory certification: CISA
* ISO 27001 or CIPM are a plus
* Language: English (written \& spoken)
* Cyber security governance, control frameworks and audit evidence expectations
* Regulatory and industry compliance topics: GDPR, NIS2, SAP security audits and SWIFT
* compliance
* User access, Segregation of Duties and identity and access fundamentals (SSO/MFA principles)
* Vulnerability management principles (risk\-based prioritisation, remediation lifecycle, reporting)
* and security awareness platforms such as KnowBe4


**Skills**
* Problem solving, with attention to detail in controls, evidence and documentation
* Written and oral communication skills — able to explain technical topics to non\-technical stakeholders
* Organization \& planning — able to track many actions through to closure and hold a reporting cadence
* Microsoft desktop applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and compliance reporting/dashboarding
* Cross\-functional collaboration with IT, OT, Legal \& Privacy and business owners; pragmatic and outcome\-focused

title: Assistant Manager- Legal, Mumbai
description:
**Location:**  

Mumbai, MH, IN

JOB PURPOSE
  
Seeking a proactive legal professional with 4\-7 years' experience in Legal Metrology and Contracts, preferably in FMCG/Manufacturing/Retail. The candidate must have hands\-on experience in Legal Metrology laws and Packaged Commodities Regulations. Responsibilities include ensuring label compliance, artwork and label approvals, stakeholder communication, legal training, and compliance audits under the Legal Metrology Act and allied rules. Candidate should have knowledge on drafting and negotiating contracts.
  
  

Primary Responsibilities
  
  

Safeguard the Company's interests by providing legal support on commercial and business transactions, drafting and negotiating contracts, minimizing legal and commercial risks, ensuring regulatory compliance, and supporting dispute management. The role will primarily focus on contract management while demonstrating willingness to support Legal Metrology compliance initiatives as required.
  
  

BUSINESS RESPONSIBILITY AREAS
  
1\. Contract Drafting \& Negotiation
  
* Draft, review, negotiate and finalize a wide range of commercial contracts, including procurement agreements, service agreements, NDAs, marketing agreements, logistics contracts, consultancy agreements, amendments and other business\-related documents.
* Identify legal, commercial and operational risks and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
* Standardize contract templates and assist in developing contracting playbooks.
* Provide legal support during negotiations with customers, vendors, service providers and other stakeholders.


2\. Legal Advisory \& Risk Management
  
* Advise business teams on contractual rights, obligations, liabilities, indemnities, warranties, limitation of liability and dispute resolution mechanisms.
* Ensure business transactions comply with applicable laws, company policies and internal approval frameworks.
* Conduct legal due diligence and support evaluation of strategic business projects.


3\. Contract Governance \& Compliance
  
* Monitor contract lifecycle management, including execution, amendments, renewals and closures.
* Maintain contract repositories and ensure proper record keeping and document management.
* Support periodic audits and compliance reviews relating to contractual obligations.


4\. Dispute \& Litigation Support
  
* Assist in managing contractual disputes, claims, legal notices and commercial disagreements arising from business transactions.
* Support assessment of legal risks, contractual exposure and dispute resolution strategies to safeguard the Company's interests.
* Coordinate with external counsel, business teams and internal stakeholders for litigation, arbitration, mediation and other dispute resolution proceedings.
* Assist in the preparation, review and management of legal notices, replies, pleadings, legal opinions, claim assessments and settlement documentation.
* Monitor ongoing litigation and dispute matters, maintain case records and ensure timely submission of required documents and information.
* Support preservation of evidence, fact\-finding exercises and internal investigations relating to contractual and commercial disputes.
* Work closely with business teams to identify contentious issues at an early stage and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
* Assist in enforcing contractual rights, remedies and dispute resolution mechanisms under various commercial agreements.
* Provide legal support in negotiating and documenting settlements, compromise arrangements and dispute closure mechanisms.
* Derive learnings from disputes and claims to strengthen contracting practices, risk allocation provisions and contract governance frameworks.
* Assist in managing contentious matters, high\-stake disputes, strategic litigation and business\-critical legal issues having significant financial, operational, regulatory or reputational impact on the Company.
* Support preparation of management updates, litigation trackers and risk reports for senior leadership and key stakeholders.


5\. Stakeholder Management \& Training
  
* Partner with Sales, Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Marketing and other business functions to provide timely legal support.
* Conduct training sessions and awareness programs on contracts, legal risks and governance requirements.


6\. Regulatory Support
  
* Track legal and regulatory developments impacting commercial contracts and business operations.
* Support implementation of legal compliance initiatives across the organization.


7\. Legal Metrology (Developmental Exposure)
  
* Demonstrate an interest and willingness to learn and support Legal Metrology compliance matters, including product labelling and packaging requirements under the Legal Metrology framework.

title: Legal Ops Specialist
description:
**Overview**
**About the Role**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and highly organized
 **Legal Operations Specialist** 
 to support the Legal Department in managing legal operations, technology, spend, matter management, outside counsel processes, and reporting.
   

  

 The successful candidate will work closely with Legal, Finance, Procurement, business stakeholders, and external law firms to ensure efficient and accurate management of legal matters and legal spend. This role will also support the administration and continuous improvement of legal technology platforms and operational processes.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities** 
**1\. Legal eBilling \& Legal Spend Management**
* Manage day\-to\-day administration of the Legal Department's electronic billing and legal spend management processes.
* Review and validate outside counsel invoices for compliance with billing guidelines, negotiated rates, billing arrangements, and applicable policies.
* Monitor invoice submissions, approvals, rejections, adjustments, and payment status.
* Support implementation and maintenance of automated invoice validation and auto\-rejection rules.
* Identify billing discrepancies, duplicate invoices, rate issues, timekeeper exceptions, and other billing violations.
* Work with law firms to resolve invoice and billing issues.
* Monitor outside counsel spend against budgets and approved matter estimates.
* Support development of cost\-saving initiatives and identify opportunities to improve legal spend efficiency.


**2\. Matter Management**
* Maintain accurate and complete legal matter records within the Legal Department's matter management system.
* Support matter opening, updates, closures, categorization, and data quality activities.
* Ensure matters are appropriately tagged by region, legal lead, matter type, agreement type, business function, and other required fields.
* Conduct periodic data cleansing and quality reviews of matter management data.
* Support matter intake and triage processes and ensure requests are routed to the appropriate Legal team member.
* Monitor aging and inactive matters and coordinate with Legal stakeholders for appropriate closure or follow\-up.


**3\. Legal Accruals \& Forecasting**
* Coordinate monthly, quarterly, and year\-end legal accrual processes with Legal, Finance, and external counsel.
* Collect and validate accrual estimates from law firms and internal Legal stakeholders.
* Track actual spend against accruals and identify significant variances.
* Support forecasting of legal spend and provide analysis of budget versus actual expenditure.
* Prepare accrual reports and supporting information for Finance and Legal leadership.
* Assist with year\-end close and audit\-related requests.


**4\. Outside Counsel \& Vendor Management**
* Support onboarding and offboarding of external law firms and legal service providers.
* Coordinate law firm setup across legal technology, eBilling, procurement, and vendor management systems.
* Maintain law firm information, billing arrangements, rate cards, matter references, and other relevant records.
* Support outside counsel guideline compliance.
* Coordinate annual rate submissions, rate reviews, and rate validation processes.
* Work with Procurement and Finance on legal vendor management and commercial arrangements.


**5\. Legal Operations Reporting \& Analytics**
* Prepare regular and ad\-hoc reports for Legal leadership and regional Legal teams.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reports covering:
+ Legal spend
+ Outside counsel spend
+ Matter volumes
+ Matter types and categories
+ Agreement types
+ Legal team workload
+ Budget versus actual spend
+ Accruals and forecasts
+ Invoice savings and rejections

* Analyze data to identify trends, risks, inefficiencies, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Support Legal leadership with data\-driven insights and recommendations.


**6\. Legal Technology \& Process Improvement**
* Support administration and optimization of Legal technology platforms, including matter management, eBilling, CLM, document management, and contract automation systems.
* Work with Legal Technology and IT teams to troubleshoot system issues and implement enhancements.
* Support user testing, system upgrades, data migration, and new functionality implementation.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual Legal Operations processes.
* Create and maintain process documentation, standard operating procedures, and user guidance.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives across the Legal Department.


**7\. Data Management \& Governance**
* Maintain high\-quality and accurate Legal Operations data across relevant systems.
* Perform periodic data audits and identify missing, duplicate, or incorrectly categorized records.
* Support data migration, cleansing, and reconciliation activities.
* Ensure appropriate controls are followed for legal matter, vendor, invoice, and spend data.
* Assist with reporting requirements, management reviews, and audit requests.


**8\. Stakeholder Management**
* Collaborate with Legal Counsel, Legal Assistants, Finance, Procurement, Accounts Payable, IT, and business stakeholders.
* Act as a point of contact for operational queries relating to legal matters, invoices, vendors, and Legal systems.
* Work with external law firms to resolve operational and billing\-related issues.
* Provide training and guidance to Legal users on relevant Legal Operations processes and systems.


**Responsibilities**
**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Legal Operations, Business Administration, Finance, Law, Management, or a related discipline .
* 3–5 years of experience in Legal Operations, Legal Spend Management, Legal eBilling, law firm billing, legal administration, or a related function.
* Hands\-on experience with electronic billing / legal spend management systems .
* Experience managing or supporting outside counsel invoices and legal spend .
* Experience with legal matter management systems and maintaining matter data.
* Experience with legal accruals, budget tracking, forecasting, and variance analysis .
* Strong Excel skills, including PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, data analysis, and reporting.
* Experience preparing management reports and analyzing operational or financial data.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage large volumes of data accurately.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple requests, and meet deadlines.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with legal technology platforms such as Brightflag, HighQ, Legal Tracker, Onit, SimpleLegal, CounselLink, Luminance, Lexion, or similar platforms .
* Experience with CLM (Contract Lifecycle Management) systems.
* Experience with Coupa, SAP, Ariba, or other procurement/ERP systems .
* Experience with Power BI or other business intelligence/reporting tools .
* Experience supporting law firm rate negotiations, rate validation, or outside counsel guideline compliance.
* Experience with legal spend optimization and identifying cost\-saving opportunities.
* Experience supporting Legal Operations transformation, system implementation, or data migration projects.
* Knowledge of legal department processes and outside counsel management.

description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full\-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision \- to simplify payments for Indian businesses \- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.
   

  

 Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.
   

  

 From building AI\-native agentic payments, to AI\-assisted fraud detection and real\-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners \- including banks, networks, regulators \- we are pioneering industry\-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech
   

  

 Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation \- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.
   

  

 Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early\-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.
   

  

 Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180\+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme \- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.
   

  

 We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India \& SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions \- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards\-first UPI) \- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

Reporting into Zeta’s India legal leadership and partnering closely with Product, Compliance, and Risk teams, the role carries significant autonomy and visibility — requiring an individual who can independently own matters end to end, negotiate directly with banks, NBFCs, and technology partners, run and manage a team of capable lawyers, and help shape the legal function of a fast\-growing, high\-growth fintech at the core of India’s digital banking transformation.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Product and platform legal support**
* Deliver day\-to\-day legal counsel across Zeta’s banking technology stack, covering card issuance, transaction processing, lending and loan management, core account and ledger functionality, and Digital Credit\-as\-a\-Service and Credit Line on UPI (CLOU), BNPL, and EMI\-conversion products.
* Advise product and engineering teams on the regulatory implications of platform features, including card management, real\-time authorization and settlement, digital lending, account lifecycle management, instrument lifecycle management (physical and virtual cards, tokens, and QR), transaction switching, and fraud and dispute management.


**Contract drafting, review, and negotiation**
* Draft, review, and negotiate agreements with banks, financial institutions, card networks, and technology partners, including platform licensing, SaaS and managed\-services arrangements, program\-management agreements, and BIN or balance\-sheet sponsorship deals underpinning Banking\-as\-a\-Service and embedded banking offerings.
* Structure co\-brand, affinity, and fintech partnership arrangements, and draft and negotiate credit card, debit card, prepaid instrument, and co\-branded card program agreements spanning retail, commercial, private\-label, and secured card products.
* Structure and paper credit lines, BNPL, and loan\-installment features and related payment and settlement arrangements, and negotiate digital lending, co\-lending, and lending service provider (LSP) agreements.
* Draft, negotiate, and manage fintech partnership, third\-party vendor, and platform licensing agreements, allocating responsibility, liability, and data\-handling obligations across Zeta, its clients, and its partners.


**Regulatory advisory**
* Advise on RBI guidelines including the Digital Lending Directions, Credit Card and Debit Card Issuance and Conduct Directions, and Master Direction on Outsourcing of IT Services; NPCI regulations governing UPI and RuPay; and PPI rules under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act — tracking evolving developments and assessing their impact on Zeta’s products and programs.
* Advise on card\-network rules, grievance redressal frameworks, and partner bank agreement requirements for card and payments programs.
* Advise on data privacy, cybersecurity, and data\-localization requirements under the DPDP Act and IT Act, and on legal considerations relevant to maintaining SOC 2, ISO 27001, and PCI DSS certifications.
* Provide legal input on regulatory filings, regulator queries and inspections, and legal risk assessments for new products and partnerships, and support the development of internal legal playbooks and templates.


**Broader legal support**
* While anchored in banking and finance law, comfortable providing practical legal support across other areas as they arise for a fast\-growing technology business, including corporate, commercial, employment, and technology or intellectual property matters.


**Skills**
* Regulatory and commercial acumen: Commercially minded, pragmatic; translates complex regulation into clear, actionable guidance for non\-legal stakeholders.
* Stakeholder management and communication: Strong communication and negotiation skills, sound and independent judgment, ability to counsel senior management strategically.
* Execution and prioritization: Highly organized and detail\-oriented; manages multiple matters simultaneously in a fast\-paced, high\-growth setting; ability to leverage AI for legal work highly preferred.
* Team leadership and people management: Ability to lead and manage a team effectively.
* Ownership and adaptability: Proactive self\-starter, energized by ambiguity, comfortable in unfamiliar areas of law, takes ownership of outcomes, thrives in a collaborative, product\-driven culture at the frontier of banking and fintech.


**Experience And Qualification**
* LLB or equivalent law degree from a recognized institution; qualified to practice law in India. LLM is a plus.
* 9–12 years of post\-qualification experience as a banking and finance lawyer, gained in a top tier law firm.
* H ands\-on expertise across digital lending, credit and debit cards, prepaid and co\-branded card programs, payments, and fintech regulation.
* Contract drafting \& negotiation: Strong contract drafting, review, and negotiation skills across commercial, technology, and financial\-services agreements.
* Working command of RBI, NPCI, and PPI frameworks.
* Experience advising on software license, SaaS, IT services, and IP licensing matters; f amiliarity with Banking\-as\-a\-Service; c ross\-border regulatory exposure.
* Proven experience leading and managing a team, including handling administrative responsibilities alongside substantive legal work.


**Equal Opportunity**
 Zeta is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds, cultures, and communities to apply and believe that a diverse workforce is key to our success
   

  

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Legal Manager
description:
**Legal Manager – Land \& Title \| 5–9 Years** 




**MSR Infraa \| Bengaluru** 




 We are looking for a
 **Legal Manager – Land \& Title** 
 who can independently examine incoming land opportunities, build the title file, identify deal\-breakers and give the Managing Director a clear
 **YES / NO / CONDITIONAL** 
 recommendation — quickly and with evidence.
 



 This is not a conventional documentation or contract\-management role.
 



 You will sit close to the
 **land acquisition and development decision\-making process** 
 , with direct responsibility for Karnataka land due diligence.
 



**What You Will Own** 




**1\. First\-Hand Land Due Diligence** 




 Every incoming land parcel, JDA proposal or outright purchase comes to you first.
 



 You will:
 


* Review title and revenue documents.
* Trace the revenue and ownership chain.
* Identify legal and documentary gaps.
* Flag deal\-breakers and potential risks.
* Prepare a clear internal title opinion note.
* Give the MD a practical
 **YES / NO / CONDITIONAL** 
 recommendation.



**Target turnaround: 7–10 working days per parcel.** 




 External senior counsel steps in
 **after your internal file is substantially clean.** 








  





**2\. Build the Complete Title File** 




 You should know exactly
 **what to collect, where to obtain it and in what sequence.** 




 Your work will include:
 


* Pahani / RTC extracts
* Mutation Register (MR)
* Akarband
* 11E Sketch
* Section 4(1\) Tippani
* Index of Lands
* 10(1\) Extract
* 30\-year Encumbrance Certificates
* Mother deed tracing
* Survey records
* Conversion orders
* Revenue and registration records



 You will own the
 **collection, sequencing, indexing and completeness** 
 of the land title file.
 







  





**3\. Construct the Mother Deed Chain** 




 You should be comfortable going deep into the ownership history of a property.
 



 Trace and analyse:
 



**Sale Deeds → Gift Deeds → Partition Deeds → Family Arrangements → Inheritance → Court Orders / Decrees → Current Ownership** 




 Your job is to identify:
 


* Breaks in the title chain
* Unregistered transfers
* Missing documents
* Inconsistent ownership records
* Unexplained gaps
* Potentially defective transactions



**A clean title chain should be understandable on one table — not buried across 200 pages of documents.** 








  





**4\. Karnataka Land Law – This Is Critical** 




 You should be able to independently identify Karnataka\-specific risks involving:
 


* **PTCL Act**
* **Inam Abolition history**
* **Karnataka Land Reforms Act – Sections 79A / 79B**
* **Section 63 and conversion status**
* Old tenancy entries in Pahani
* Land ceiling
* Gramathana vs. revenue land
* BBMP / BDA / BMRDA jurisdiction
* Mutation and survey issues
* Phodi / re\-survey matters



**You should see the trap before the transaction gets into it.** 








  





**5\. Revenue \& Registry Liaison** 




 This is a hands\-on role.
 



 You should have direct experience working with:
 


* Tahsildar Office
* Sub\-Registrar Office
* Survey Department
* Assistant Commissioner
* Deputy Commissioner Office



 You should understand
 **which authority issues which document, what the practical turnaround is, and how to move a stuck file forward.** 




 We are looking for someone who has
 **personally handled these processes** 
 , not someone who has only instructed junior staff to do them.
 







  





**6\. Existing Project Title Files** 




 You will maintain and close documentation gaps for our ongoing projects and upcoming projects.
 



 When a bank, buyer, auditor or internal team asks for a document, you should be able to retrieve it quickly.
 



**Our expectation: any critical title document should be retrievable within 24 hours.** 








  





**7\. Buyer Documentation** 




 Approximately
 **30% of your role** 
 will involve project\-level legal documentation, including:
 


* Agreements of Sale
* Construction Agreements
* Sale Deeds
* Tripartite Agreements with home\-loan banks
* NOCs
* Cancellations
* Nomination changes







  





**8\. K\-RERA Execution** 




 You will support the execution and ongoing compliance process, including:
 


* Quarterly filings
* Amendment tracking
* Agent registrations
* Documentation and records



 Major drafting and registrations will continue to be supported by external counsel.
 







  





**What You Will NOT Own** 




 We have deliberately defined this role.
 



**You will not be responsible for:** 



* ❌ Issuing formal bank title opinions — external senior counsel will do this.
* ❌ Drafting major K\-RERA registration applications — external counsel handles this.
* ❌ Leading complex land litigation — external counsel leads; you manage facts and timelines.
* ❌ Tax, GST, stamp duty strategy — handled by our CA firm.
* ❌ Chasing building plan approvals — handled by the approvals consultant.



**Your job is to make the land transaction legally clear enough for the business to make an informed decision.** 








  





**Must\-Have Experience** 




**Qualification** 



* LLB from a recognised Indian university.
* Bar Council enrolment is preferred, but not mandatory.



**Experience** 



* **5–9 years PQE.**
* Minimum
 **4 years of hands\-on Karnataka land due diligence** 
 .
* Experience in one or more of the following environments:
* Bengaluru real estate developer's land/legal team
* Property law firm handling title opinions
* Bank\-panel title\-search practice with developer clients



**Technical Knowledge** 




 You should be able to independently read and interpret:
 


* Pahani / RTC
* Mutation Register
* Akarband
* 11E Sketch
* Section 4(1\) Tippani
* Phodi / Podi records
* Revenue records



 You should have working knowledge of:
 


* Karnataka Land Revenue Act
* Karnataka Land Reforms Act
* Sections 79A / 79B
* Section 63
* PTCL Act
* Inam Abolition Acts
* Karnataka Stamp Act
* Registration Act



**One Non\-Negotiable** 




**Kannada reading is required.** 




 Original Karnataka revenue records are frequently in Kannada. We need someone who can read and interpret them directly without depending on a translator for routine diligence.
 







  





**We Would Particularly Value** 



* Experience drafting and negotiating
 **Joint Development Agreements (JDAs)** 
 .
* Experience with Gramathana / revenue\-site / conversion disputes.
* Record\-of\-rights rectification and mutation corrections.
* Phodi / re\-survey issues.
* Land aggregation involving
 **4–6\+ acres and multiple landowners** 
 .
* Experience with land in Bengaluru's growth corridors and peripheral zones such as
 **Jakkur, Thanisandra, Yelahanka, Hennur, Doddaballapur Road, Sarjapur and Whitefield periphery.**







  





**What Success Looks Like** 




 Within your first year, we want to see a land legal function where:
 



**Every incoming parcel is screened systematically.** 




**Deal\-breakers are identified early.** 




**Title files are complete and structured.** 




**The MD gets a clear commercial legal view — not a 100\-page document dump.** 




**External counsel spends time validating and resolving the important issues, rather than discovering basic gaps.** 




**Land acquisition decisions become faster, better documented and significantly more predictable.** 








  





**If You Can Look at a Land File and Tell Us What Can Kill the Deal — We Want to Meet You.** 




**Role:** 
 Legal Manager – Land \& Title
 



**Experience:** 
 5–9 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Bengaluru
 



**Industry:** 
 Real Estate / Land Acquisition
 



**Focus:** 
 Karnataka Land Due Diligence \& Title
 



**Apply with your CV and a brief note highlighting your experience in Karnataka land title diligence.** 




*Shortlisted candidates may be asked to share a sanitised sample of an internal title opinion note.*

title: Investigating Officer
description:
**Job Purpose** 




 As an Investigation Team member, the candidate will play a pivotal role in conducting investigation globally for thorough and comprehensive investigations into various matters, such as corporate fraud, misconduct, compliance violations, security breaches, or other incidents. The candidate will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of the investigation process, ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards, and delivering actionable findings and recommendations to senior management or relevant stakeholders.
 



  





 The Investigation Team Lead plays a crucial role in safeguarding the organization's reputation, ensuring compliance, and mitigating risks through effective and ethical investigations. This role demands a leader who can balance legal, ethical, and organizational considerations while leading a dedicated team.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




  





**Planning \& Handling Investigations** 



1. Carry out end\-to\-end investigations by ensuring that all prescribed investigative / operating methodologies for the various types of investigations are adhered to and by conducting proper planning on all investigations.
2. Obtain all relevant evidence related to an investigation. Scrutinize / analyse this evidence and make meaningful observations / conclusions regarding the findings and make appropriate recommendations.
3. Ensure that witnesses / suspects and victims are interviewed and where necessary obtain written statements.
4. Compile investigation reports as per the prescribed operating methodology, containing the findings of investigations.
5. Ensure that each investigation has an accurate, value\- adding conclusion for the type of investigation conducted.
6. Make meaningful recommendations as per the type of investigation. This will include, but not limited to, system / people / process failures or internal and external threats.
7. Assist reporting manager/ HoD and other team (e.g. HR) with relevant findings / documentation for use in disciplinary processes.
8. Ensure that each investigation is concluded within the prescribed and acceptable time limit for the particular type of investigation.
9. Inform management of any suggestions or proposals to enhance investigative methodology / operating procedure.
10. Collect timely intelligence to avert fraud and Security incidences



  





**Team Leadership** 



1. Supervise, mentor, and provide guidance to a team of investigators.
2. Foster a collaborative and productive work environment
3. Assign and prioritize investigation tasks based on urgency and importance.



  





**Interviews and Interrogations** 



1. Conduct interviews with relevant individuals, both employees and external parties.
2. Maintain objectivity and professionalism during interviews.
3. Document findings accurately and ethically.



  





**Case Management** 



1. To maintain case files and central investigations database to operational standards.
2. To attend progress meetings with HoD and concerned management teams.
3. Ensure credible information is provided for MIs produced by Investigation team.
4. Prepare and submit whistle\-blowing reports to the Head of Department. This will also include summary slides to be presented in other management forums like Audit Committee.
5. Support HR and Risk management teams in Fraud Awareness, training and sensitization Campaigns



  





**Risk Identification and Awareness** 



1. Ensure that all risks and/or emerging risks, which are identified during an investigation / interaction with stakeholders, are escalated to line management upon discovery.
2. Identify high\-risk business units and were requested to do so, participate in awareness initiatives.



  





**Stakeholder Management** 



1. Develop and maintain relationships with internal and external stakeholders to build synergies and teamwork.
2. Actively interact with counterparts in the industry to gain understanding of threats and risks and to share important information on current frauds and fraudsters involved.
3. Any other duty as may be assigned Head of security \& Investigations.



  





**Ideal Job Specifications** 



1. Chartered Accountant, MBA (in Finance and Risk Management)
2. Hold a professional qualification in a relevant field such as CFE.
3. Minimum 5\-10 years of professional experience with investigatory procedures and practice.
4. Relevant certifications (e.g., Certified Fraud Examiner, Certified Professional Investigator) is a plus.
5. Preferred experience in Pharma or Big 4 (Investigation) or any other industry is preferred.
6. Experience in handling Hot\-line
7. Expertise in investigation technique, particularly where conduct involve criminal implications that could result in prosecution before local courts.
8. Strong analytical and critical\-thinking skills.
9. Leadership and team management skills
10. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
